summary: Max Verstappen won the Emilia Romagna Grand Prix from pole position, 0.7s ahead of Lando Norris, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Kevin Magnussen made the biggest climb, from P18 to P12.
Daniel Ricciardo had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P13.
There were 27 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 48 points over Charles Leclerc.
